acceptance_gate: Theorems 1-3 are proved in prose; check.py verifies ranks against finite moves and entropy bounds on eleven laws, knot censuses with knotlab and nativity on five laws, and world-independence, with three controls rejected.
objective: For locally finite GF(2)-linear laws, prove: (1) a parity is changed by a finite change at one solution exactly when at every solution, exactly when a finitely supported homogeneous solution changes it, so nativity does not depend on the world; (2) a finite set of at least three variables carries a K1-K3 knot exactly when it is a minimal support of a fixed parity, and under the source-aware reading the knot is native exactly when every variable lies in the support of a finite move; (3) for a shift-invariant law on Z^d with n variable types, finitely supported homogeneous solutions exist exactly when the law's polynomial matrix has rank below n, exactly when the solution space has positive topological entropy. Check on Tseitin, the gauge (plaquette) law, Ledrappier and the combined Tseitin-gauge law on Z^2, plus seeded random laws: generic ranks, finite moves in boxes, box entropies, minimal fixed parities with knotlab, and nativity.
status: Proved by FROZEN-WORLDS-20261020-001B-P001 (prose with checks): for GF(2)-linear laws nativity does not depend on the world, so a linear law is frozen everywhere or has the same finite moves everywhere; K1-K3 knots are exactly the minimal supports of fixed parities and are native under the source-aware reading exactly when inside the supports of finite moves; on Z^d native loops exist exactly when the law's matrix has a rank deficit, equivalently positive entropy. On Z^2 Tseitin and the gauge law have native knots; Ledrappier's law and the combined Tseitin-gauge law are frozen, with knots but no native knot. Classical in substance (Schmidt; Lind-Schmidt-Ward); the reading is the program's.
stop_rule: Stop and record the gap if a rank, finite-move, entropy, knot or nativity check fails on a declared law.
title: Proof: a linear law is frozen everywhere or nowhere
